_comment: Hand-written enrichment merged on top of the spec introspected from the live
Express router (lib/openapiFromRoutes.js). Keys of the form 'METHOD /express/path'
target one operation; every other top-level key is merged into the document root.
Use the Express path exactly as registered (':id', not '{id}').
Overlay values win over generated ones. A key that matches no route fails the
openapiFromRoutes test — that is the guard against this file rotting.

GET /api/accounts.description: Returns every account in the demo data store, enriched with owner username, email and display name. Requires the admin role — a signed-in non-admin gets 403. Paginate with `limit` and `offset`; omitting both returns the full set.

403.description: Signed in, but not an admin.

GET /api/accounts/my.summary: List the signed-in customer's own accounts
GET /api/accounts/my.description: The customer-facing counterpart to `GET /api/accounts`. Rejected for admin sessions.

GET /api/accounts/:id/balance.description: Requires the `read` scope on the presented token in addition to a session.

GET /api/use-cases.description: Public, read-only. Each entry carries an `auth` level (`public` | `user` | `admin`) sourced from config/auth-requirements.json — the UI gates tiles and routes on that field rather than on a fresh sign-in check.
